states.fixed: Deterministic values or reviewed rule matches are authoritative and are not overwritten by analyzer output; semantic contributions from matched reviewed rules remain known-partial and additive.
states.known_partial: Deterministic values are known but may be augmented by LLM output.
states.unresolved: No deterministic value is available; the field remains LLM-owned.
states.fallback: A deterministic fallback is used only when fixed and LLM values are absent.
states.mixed: A field may contain fixed keys, known-partial values, and unresolved semantics; each entry retains ownership provenance.

field_contract.intent: Fixed when a high-confidence route matches; otherwise unresolved and LLM-owned.
field_contract.target_repositories: Known-partial deterministic references are augmented by valid LLM repositories; unresolved repository meaning remains LLM-owned.
field_contract.requested_versions: Explicit repository+SHA values are fixed for matching repositories; unresolved version values remain LLM-owned.
field_contract.symbols: Symbols contributed by a matched reviewed expansion are known_partial additive values; the reviewed rule match is fixed_reviewed_rule and LLM output may augment symbols.
field_contract.concepts: Concepts contributed by a matched reviewed expansion are known_partial additive values; the reviewed rule match is fixed_reviewed_rule and LLM output may augment concepts.
field_contract.concept_scopes: Fallback scopes are merged first, LLM scopes next, and fixed deterministic scopes last so fixed > LLM > fallback holds.
field_contract.resolved_aliases: Accepted aliases and correction messages are fixed with provenance.
field_contract.reviewed_expansions: Reviewed expansion rule identifiers/matches are fixed_reviewed_rule; symbols, concepts, and repositories contributed by a matched rule are known_partial additive inputs.
field_contract.version_conflicts: Plan conflicts are evaluated after the fixed/LLM version merge and remain observable.

diagnostic_contract.ownership_provenance_shape: Each provenance entry records source and rule, optional value, and ownership.

repository_boundary_contract.reason: Repository matching uses token boundaries and does not accept a larger containing token.

preserved_contracts: Accepted aliases and reviewed-expansion rule matching
